relevance_note: The paper reports four individual patients with TNFAIP3 variants: "WES revealed heterozygous c.559C > T in the TNFAIP3 gene in P1, P2 and P3, while the c.259C > T mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene was identified in P4".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; built the JSON with a short Python script in the scratch directory that only formats my readings and resolves thin/no-break spaces in spans. Labels: the text uses P1-P4 most often (Table 1/2 use bare numbers, Table 3 'Case 1/2/4'), so rule 1 gives P1-P4. Table 3 has patients as columns (Case 1 pre/post, Case 2 pre/post, Case 4 pre/post); I used only the pretherapy columns, spans run from the row label through the cell. No stacked ' / ' cells. Table symbols '–' and '+' in Table 3 are not defined by a legend; '+' read as positive only for anti-dsDNA P1 (column 1); '–' cells not used for exclusions. Relatives: P4's parents tested negative ('the mutation was not found in her parents') get rows as 'parent of P4' and 'parent of P4 2'. Other family 1 members ('not detected in other members in family 1'; Fig. 3 legend lists mother and grandparents) are not individually described in the text, so they get no rows. P3 inheritance: authors call the variant de novo for P3, but the text never states that P3's own parents were tested, so inheritance is 'not reported'. P1/P2 inherited paternal from P3 (Table 2 'Father'; 'P3 ... transmitted it to his children'). Group exclusions of eye/skin problems come from 'All patients had no signs of eye or skin problems' (all four named as the group). Table 2 'No' cells used as explicit absence (Musculoskeletal, Intestinal, Thyroid, Liver, lung, Cardiovascular, Fever). Contradictions: (1) P2 onset 2.5 years (Table 1) vs 'polyarthritis at age 2.6' (text); recorded the table value. (2) P4 current age 8.3 years (Table 1) vs '9-year-old' (text), and onset 6.9 years (Table 1) vs 'at the age of 7 years' (text); recorded table values. (3) P4 oral ulcers in text vs Table 2 Ulcers 'No'; both rows emitted, checklist oral ulcers not reported, genital ulcers left not reported. (4) P2 Table 2 Ulcers 'No' vs endoscopic multiple GI ulcers; both rows emitted; GI checklist kept observed because Crohn's disease (inflammation) is uncontradicted. (5) P1 'other autoantibodies were negative' vs Table 3 anti-dsDNA '+' pretherapy; P4 'positive ANA and anti-ds DNA antibodies' vs 'no other autoantibody was detected' (and Table 3 anti-dsDNA '–'); both rows emitted; autoantibody checklist still observed via ANA. (6) Fig. 2e/2f legends assign knee synovitis and ILD to P3, while the text cites Fig. 2e/2f for P4 and Table 2 gives P3 lung 'No'; emitted both rows for P3, ILD checklist not reported for P3. (7) P4 Table 2 Liver 'No' vs raised ALT/AST in text; autoimmune hepatitis checklist left not reported for P4. (8) P4 treatment: Table 1 current treatment includes CSA and diclofenac, text lists etanercept with low dose prednisolone only. Conservative choices: pericardial effusion/ascites (P1) not mapped to serositis; P1 cytopenias not marked 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' because the paper does not call them autoimmune; P1 hypothyroidism not mapped to autoimmune thyroiditis; P3 anal fistula/archosyrinx not mapped to GI ulcers or inflammation; 'fever of unknown origin' (P2, P4) not counted as recurrent fever. is_proband: only P1 is called proband; P2-P4 left null. Vital status not stated explicitly for anyone.
